consumer: The offline map-dump file (fed by the export writer write_tiles), which records the true terrain id of each tile and asks 'what is the raw terrain id at this tile?' — it holds the value, not SHOW/EVALUATE/perform/present it.
scope: a map region — every nearby tile within the export window/radius, not a single tile or carried inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles — its body writes ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() (the raw terrain string id) straight from world state with no filtering, visibility shading, or formatting, i.e. authoritative simulation state
divergence: An unseen or memorized tile whose real underlying terrain is t_floor: raw world state must emit "t_floor", but a display/observability (D) answer would emit a remembered-stale id or t_unknown, exposing the wrong authority
